intent.t: CORE AIM (Owner, 22 Oct): a personal-use app for one Grade 9 kid to self-learn difficult Physics, Maths and Chemistry concepts for a top competitive exam. Not a corporate product.

PIPELINE (Owner, 22 Oct): question bank -> Core 2 with QRT label, hint ladder, reasoning route, teacher's answer -> per fixed QRT tile: Core 1A/1B -> questionnaire (Core 1B/2B) finds the kid's demand -> Core 2B by demand.

Owner, 22 Oct, "ok update": deliver one complete learning interaction first. Capture initial demand with a few existing prompts; preserve question identity/provenance, QRT meanings and non-author checks. Automated properties and actual learner evidence remain separate.

LEARNER (Owner, 23 Oct, to Oracle O5): Grade 10 (the project name says Grade 9); target JEE Main ("JEE Main is target", replacing "JEE advanced"); exam year later; textbook-quality material. Central need: the kid explains why, breaks the idea into parts, and applies it. Replaces "Grade 9 kid" and "top competitive exam" in CORE AIM (22 Oct).

ORACLE OWNS IT (Owner, 23 Oct): "just create P1 with 7 question, explain concept to codex, oracle, let him do the rest!" OTM explains the concept, the workflow, the facts and the fixed rules to Oracle O5 (TO G9O5-2, G9O5-2a). O5 decides the design, the picks and the build route. The Owner tries the page first.

QRT RULE (Owner, 23 Oct): "QRT has 7x4. so min 7 types of question in a topic is required! Follow question is unnecessary!" A topic starts with one question per demand (7 demands x bands D1-D4) to find the kid's demand profile; no follow-up question. P1 and P2 did not meet it; P2 was stopped.

DISCUSSION (Owner with Oracle O5, 23 Oct, RE G9O5-0a to 1b), O5's proposal, not accepted: a 38-min Newton's third law session; a roadmap from one Physics session to Maths, Chemistry and harder problems at JEE Main depth. After the QRT rule, the session is the teaching for the demands the diagnostic shows broken.

OWNER (23 Oct 22:14, on QRT-P2): "'Fresh Re-Check' to be avoidable, it should be linked with Core 1B or 2B, check in the repo." The re-check after a lesson is not a new invented step; it uses the repo's own Core1B (reconstruction) or Core2B (transfer, a specified changed demand) roles and their existing NLM items.

OWNER (23 Oct 22:25): QRT-P1 is done (diagnostic by questionnaire); no P2 loop, no independent-check loop, no PR loop; OTM screenshots not a priority. "start preparing Core 1A then 1B based on demand against each topic. IDEA IS Blueprint+Topicwise Adapter for each QRT tile => Core1A/1B structure, then compile them".

OWNER (23 Oct 22:28): "No further P1/P2 required, need to start building all 28 tiles. But priority is D3,D4 for common tile in a topic ex: NLM apply, implement. Motion in 1D may be others. To save time priorities on Top 10."

"For reference ONLY not golden fixtures, MAY REUSE."

OWNER (23 Oct 22:42): plan as a WBS, "prove with NLM first". Top 10 tiles from reference banks + Oracle judgement (JEE past-question frequency only if it does not burn tokens). Output "Like the olympiad master suite" for the Owner's validation. ChatGPT content work: OTM may use the built-in browser, already signed in.
